no_api_findings.finding: The documented standard library has no ASCII PBM, PGM, or PPM parser. std::fs::read and std::io::Read provide bytes without interpreting P1, P2, or P3 dimensions and samples. No format-aware bundled API was available to run against the valid controls.

limit: This covers the documented Rust 1.99.1 standard library; third-party crates and native FLTK are separate.
